tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thub pa'i bstan pa srung ba'i ye shes kyi mgon po mched brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i

dbang gi chu bo chen po bzhugs so// thub pa'i bstan pa srung ba'i dpal mgon po brgyad kyi zhal nye bar blta ba'i dbang gi chu rgyun chen po/ bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// thub bstan rgyal po mchog gi lhun po che// yongs rdzogs dpag bsam ljon pa'i rgyan dang bcas| |mi mthun lha min tshogs las bsrung mdzad pa// ye shes mgon po mched brgyad la phyag 'tshal// 'dir mgon po mched brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ stegs bu'i steng du rdul tshon gyi dal mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ de'i nye logs su mgon po brgyad yum dang bcas pa'i gtor ma tsaka li rgyan dang ldan pa/ bum pa/ nang mchod/ rdor dril/ mkho ba'i yo byad rnams nyer bsdogs byas la las gzhung bsrangs/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas gdong g.yogs dang bcas pas| sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang// sogs kyis sdom pa bzung*/ slob ma'i snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur par dmigs la gsang bar gdam pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i gsang ba dam pa 'di khyod kyis dal ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes brjod de/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra ba dang*/

tshul 'di'i gsang mtshan brjod par gyur na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi dam tshig gi rdo rjes/ khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems shing rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ dam chu sbyin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub kun// rdo rje bdud rtsi chu 'dis 'grub// ces dang*/ slob mas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā sa ma ya pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ zhes brjod/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste khyod kyi rdo rje slob dpon nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos/ nga la brnyas par byas na khyod da lta nyid du tshe'i dus byas te dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ byin brlab pa ni/ slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ dpal ldan nag po chen po'i ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ mdun bskyed ltar dmigs pa sprad/ byin dbab/ rol mo bsgrags la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang*/ rdo rjes brtan par byas/ slob mas me tog thogs te/ nag po chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// rigs pa'i me tog 'di dor nas// sngon las 'phro zhig gang yod pa'i// dkyil 'khor lha la bdag sprod cig /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes dor/ gsang mtshan du khrag 'thung he ru ka'am/ rdo rje nag po chen po sogs gang rung gdags/ mig thur thogs nas/ ye shes mgon pos deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med| |oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā pā sh+ya hoḥ

rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su ye shes kyi rang mdangs las grub pa'i nag po chen po'i lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i rim pa'o// dngos gzhi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob mas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la| |mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nag po chen po deng bdag stsol// ces gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs dngos su bzhugs pa'i mgon po brgyad kyi phyag na rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad yo bar bzung ste dbang bskur bar/ las mgon rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ yum gyis dbang bskur ba'i srung ma mdzad/ lha mo brgyad kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod bzhin par gyur par dmigs te/ yum gyi bum pa thogs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// bum pa'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes rtsa sngags kyi mjug tu/ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur zhing bum chu sbyin/ des bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ sku rdo rje'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes dag pa brjod/ de nas gsang ba'i dbang ni thod pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// nag po chen po byang chub sems// gsang ba'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes rtsa sngags brjod/ des gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag

/lam zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes dag pa brjod/ de nas skye med bris sku sbyin zhing*/ phyogs bcu sangs rgyas sras bcas kyis// sbyor sgrol gnyis med thabs chen po// shes rab rjes 'gro puṇ+ḍa ri// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur sbyin| |zhes rtsa sngags brjod cing lag tu gtad/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam sbyor sgrol gyi rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag |'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes dag pa brjod/ de nas me long lag tu sbyin la/ nag po chen po he ru kaḥ /rang byung rig pa'i ye shes mchog /dwangs zhing gsal la rnyog pa med// snang stong 'dzin med chos kyi sku// tshig gi dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes pa nas rtsa sngags brjod cing gtad/ des dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag |lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ gdod ma'i mgon po he ru ka'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes brjod/ rdor dril sbyin zhing*/ nag po chen po'i ming gi dbang*// ye shes rdo rje ming gi dbang*// rtag pa'i rdo rje nges mdzad phyir// bu khyod deng 'dir dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā badz+ra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ ye shes dpal/ zhes dri/ slob mas che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa la'o// zhes brjod/ des ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga'i dri ma dag /nag po chen po'i mtshan gyis nges pa rtogs pa dang*/ de'i phrin las sgrub pa la dbang*/ ye shes lnga'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa nye bar bsgrub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so/

/zhes brjod/ de nas gtor dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*// log 'dren dgra bgegs tshar gcod phyir// ye shes mgon po mched brgyad kyi// gtor ma'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol// ces gsol ba gdab/ dbus kyi gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje nag po chen po mthu bo che// mthing nag rab 'jigs khro chas gar dgu ldan// gri gug ral gri thod khrag rtse gsum 'dzin// dbugs bral gdan la tsan+dan 'khyil stabs bzhugs// phrin las mi zad cho 'phrul stobs mnga' ba// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa pa ma hā kā lā ba liṃ a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ mdun gyi gtor ma thogs te/ ma mo'i ded dpon thugs yum tsan+ḍi ka /nag po phyag bzhi mi sdug lang tsho can// ral gri rtse gsum mda' gzhu dgra mgo 'dzin// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /g.yas kyi gtor ma thogs te/ hūm̐ */ myur mdzad ma hā kā lā phyag drug pa// gri gug thod phreng ḍā ru thod khrag dang*// rtse gsum zhags 'dzin bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi| |dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /rgyab kyi gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐ */ gur mgon mche gtsigs mthing nag phyag gnyis pa// gri gug thod khrag rnam 'phrul gan+ḍi 'dzin// mi ro'i gdan brjid 'gying bag gar gyis bzhengs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /g.yon gyi gtor ma thogs te/ hūm̐ */ tsa turmu kha mdog can mi sdug gzugs// phyag bzhi gri gug thod khrag ral gri dang*// rus phreng bdud rtsi bum pa 'dzin mdzad pa// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog

/shar lho'i gtor ma thogs te/ hūm̐ */ smug nag 'jigs gzugs tsan+dan beng chen ni// g.yas pa beng dbyug g.yon pa lcags par 'dzin// dar nag ber gyon ro yi gdan la bzhugs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /lho nub kyi gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐ */ dpal mgon ma ning mdog nag phyag gnyis pa// rtse gsum thod khrag thogs te rgyan dang ldan// ber nag gsol zhing ro steng dgyes par bzhugs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /nub byang gi gtor ma thogs te/ hūm̐ */ stag zhon nag po phyag gnyis gri gug dang*// g.yon pas thod pa khrag bkang dar nag gi// gos gyon stag gi steng bzhugs khro gtum gyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /byang shar gyi gtor ma thogs te/ hūm̐ */ ngal bsos dge ba rnam mang thos kyi bu// gser mdog rgyal mtshan ne'u le dgyes shing 'dzin// rin chen rgyan phreng seng ge dkar po bcibs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /las mgon gnyis kyi gtor ma thogs te/ hūm̐ */ mi sdug bya rog gdong can mdog nag cing*// gri khug thod khrag rngam stabs tshul du 'dzin// sha za seng gdong khro tshul sku mdog nag /ral gri thod khrag 'dzin pas kun tu rgyug /dgra gshed mthu stobs ldan pa'i dpa' bo che// las kyi mgon po mched gnyis 'khor bcas kyi// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dbang bzhi ye shes rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog /ces so so'i mjug tu rang rang gi rtsa sngags btags la dbang bskur/ des ye shes kyi mgon po brgyad kyi sku bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*| gsung snying po bzla ba dang*/ thugs ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa dang*/

de dag gi dbang bskur ba dang*/ las bzhi'i phrin las bsgrub pa dang*/ las mtha' phran bu'i skor sna tshogs bsgrub pa dang*/ 'chad cing ston pa dang*/ nyams su blang ba la dbang ba yin no// de nas bzlas pa'i lung bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po brgyad kyi zhal du zhugs/ dbu ma'i nang brgyud gsang gnas nas thon te slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ yig g.yas skor du 'khor bas/ sngags bzla ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur pa'i thugs 'dun dang bcas pa'i ngang nas rtsa sngags lan gsum rjes zlos mdzod/ de nas slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi| |bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis/ mgon po 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol| |phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod cing me tog dor/ de dag gis mgon po brgyad kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs par bsrung ba'i dam tshig srung bar khas blangs/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal sogs brjod/ mjug tu thugs dam bskul ba dang gshegs bsdu sogs las gzhan ltar bya'o// zhes pa 'di mgon po mched brgyad kyi zhal nye bar lta ba'i dbang gi chu bo chen po 'di'ang*/ dge slong dharma kīrtis shing yos chu stod zla bar khrom gzhung du sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ//
